<thought>We need the number of methyl groups in the unknown molecule. The only way to determine this without a given structure is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum (which shows carbon environments) and count the signals in the typical methyl region (~10‑30 ppm). This requires the carbon_nmr_spectra tool, which takes no arguments and returns the spectrum for the sample at hand. Once we have the spectrum we can count the methyl carbon signals and provide the integer answer.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
